enonce.texte:
You have been asked to present a summary of your technical communication skills to a potential employer. Write a self-assessment report (250-300 words) that includes:

  • A summary of your strengths in technical communication (e.g., writing, presenting, discussing).
  • An analysis of your weaknesses (e.g., pronunciation, technical writing, public speaking).
  • A specific action plan with at least 3 concrete steps to improve.
  • A timeline for achieving your goals.

questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse :

**Self-Assessment Report - Technical Communication Skills**

**Strengths:**
I have strong skills in writing technical documentation, including README files and API documentation. I can explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and I am comfortable participating in daily stand-up meetings and code reviews. I am also proficient in using professional vocabulary for software engineering.

**Weaknesses:**
I need to improve my public speaking skills, especially in delivering technical presentations. My pronunciation of certain technical terms (e.g., 'algorithm', 'asynchronous') could be clearer. I also struggle with writing concise yet comprehensive technical specifications.

**Action Plan:**
1. **Public Speaking:** Join a local Toastmasters club to practice delivering technical presentations. (Start: Next month, Duration: 3 months)
2. **Pronunciation:** Practice difficult technical terms using online pronunciation tools (e.g., Forvo, YouGlish) for 15 minutes daily. (Start: Immediately, Duration: Ongoing)
3. **Technical Writing:** Write a weekly technical blog post to practice writing concisely. (Start: Next week, Duration: Ongoing)

**Timeline:**
I aim to see significant improvement in my presentation skills within 3 months and in my writing within 6 months. I will seek feedback from my peers and mentors to track progress.

enonce.texte:
Read the following list of common challenges faced by software engineers in technical communication. Rank them from 1 (most challenging) to 5 (least challenging) for you personally, and explain why.

  • Writing clean and readable code comments.
  • Presenting technical solutions to stakeholders.
  • Participating in code reviews and giving feedback.
  • Writing professional emails and documentation.
  • Communicating with non-technical team members.

questions.texte: Rank the challenges and explain your ranking.
questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse :

1. **Presenting technical solutions to stakeholders** - I get nervous speaking in front of groups.
2. **Communicating with non-technical team members** - I find it difficult to simplify technical concepts.
3. **Participating in code reviews** - I sometimes struggle to phrase feedback constructively.
4. **Writing professional emails** - I am confident in my writing skills.
5. **Writing code comments** - I am good at documenting my code.

enonce.texte:
You are a senior software engineer at a company. Your team has just completed a major feature, but the deployment failed due to a configuration error. You need to communicate this to three different audiences:

  • Audience A: The engineering team (technical details, next steps).
  • Audience B: The project manager (impact on timeline, action plan).
  • Audience C: The CEO (summary, business impact, reassurance).

Write a brief communication for each audience.

questions.texte: Write the communication for the engineering team.
questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse :

**Subject: Deployment Failure - Action Required**

Hi Team,

The deployment of the new feature failed at 2:00 PM due to a misconfigured environment variable in the production config. We are rolling back to the previous version immediately.

**Root Cause:**
- Environment variable 'API_URL' was set to 'staging-api' instead of 'prod-api'.

**Next Steps:**
1. Rollback to v2.1.0.
2. Fix the config file.
3. Re-run the deployment pipeline after approval.

Please join the incident channel #incident-2026-06-15 for coordination.

questions.texte: Write the communication for the project manager.
questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse :

**Subject: Deployment Issue - Impact and Plan**

Hi [PM Name],

The deployment of the new feature failed today due to a configuration error. We are rolling back and expect to have a fix deployed within 2 hours.

**Impact on Timeline:**
- The release will be delayed by one day.
- We will prioritize this and update the schedule accordingly.

**Action Plan:**
- Fix the configuration.
- Test the fix in staging.
- Deploy to production.

I will keep you updated on progress.

questions.texte: Write the communication for the CEO.
questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse :

**Subject: Deployment Update**

Dear [CEO Name],

I wanted to inform you that today's deployment of the new feature was temporarily delayed due to a configuration error. Our team identified the issue immediately and is working on a fix.

**Business Impact:**
- No customer impact as the feature was not yet live.
- The release will be delayed by one day.

**Reassurance:**
The team is fully focused on resolving this, and we are confident in the solution. I will provide a final update by end of day.

enonce.texte:
You have received the following feedback from your manager:

  • "Your technical writing is good, but you need to improve your presentation skills. You tend to rush through your slides and don't make enough eye contact. Also, your documentation could be more concise."

Create a detailed improvement plan that includes:

  • Specific goals (SMART goals).
  • Actions to achieve each goal.
  • Resources you will use.
  • A timeline for implementation.
  • How you will measure success.

questions.reponse:
Exemple de réponse :

**Improvement Plan**

**Goal 1: Improve Presentation Skills**
- **Specific:** Deliver 3 presentations in the next 3 months with improved pacing and eye contact.
- **Measurable:** Receive feedback ratings of 4/5 or higher from audience surveys.
- **Achievable:** Practice each presentation with a colleague before the actual event.
- **Relevant:** Improves communication with stakeholders.
- **Time-bound:** Complete within 3 months.

**Actions:**
1. Join a Toastmasters club to practice public speaking.
2. Record and review my practice sessions.
3. Prepare detailed speaker notes and practice with a timer.

**Resources:** Toastmasters, YouTube tutorials, presentation software.

**Goal 2: Improve Conciseness in Documentation**
- **Specific:** Reduce the length of my documentation by 20% while maintaining clarity.
- **Measurable:** Track word count and get feedback from peers.
- **Achievable:** Revise existing documents and apply editing techniques.
- **Relevant:** Improves efficiency and readability.
- **Time-bound:** Complete within 2 months.

**Actions:**
1. Study examples of concise technical writing.
2. Use active voice and avoid redundancy.
3. Ask a peer to review and suggest edits.

**Resources:** Style guides, online writing tools (Grammarly, Hemingway).

**Success Measurement:**
- Feedback from manager and peers.
- Improvement in presentation ratings.
- Reduced time spent on documentation revisions.
